h1.en: WHAT are Durability Concerns: concrete pump spectacle plate
h1.zh: 耐久性要关心哪些问题：S阀眼镜板：点检要求观察，尺寸没有印出

directAnswer.en: Durability concerns is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names the spectacle plate on the published daily checklist as something to observe with the S-valve. No outer diameter, carbide grade or replacement hour is printed for it, and there is no separate product page that assigns a size. The published spare on the same circuit is the S-tube seal kit. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number.

heading.zh: 耐久性要关心哪些问题

body.en: Under the source heading “WHAT are Durability Concerns”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. The published table prints Part type S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit; Large-end sizes listed φ210 / φ220 / φ250 (set; some six-piece); Small-end sizes listed φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105; Unit Set. Those seal-kit cells belong to the S-tube seal page. They are not a size for the spectacle plate.
body.zh: 在来源标题“耐久性要关心哪些问题”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。已公布参数表印有：配件类型S管大端与小端密封套件；已列大端尺寸φ210 / φ220 / φ250（套；部分为六件套）；已列小端尺寸φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105；单位套。这些密封套件格子属于 S 管密封页，不是眼镜板的尺寸。

body.en: Under the source heading “WHY should Durability be Addressed”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. The photograph on this page is a content image downloaded from the crawled source page. It is not a Pinjin catalogue sheet. A diameter, output, distance or material grade is used here only when the Xingtai table prints it. Figures that are not readable on the photograph stay blank. Another manufacturer's rating is not written onto this Pinjin model or part. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number.
body.zh: 在来源标题“为什么要处理耐久性”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。本文图片是从来源页正文下载的内容图，不是品锦目录页。直径、产量、距离或材料牌号，只有邢台参数表印了才写入。照片上读不出来的数字保持空白。其他厂家的参数不写到这个品锦型号或配件上。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。

body.en: Under the source heading “HOW Should Durability be Addressed”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Photograph the spectacle plate and name the pump model on the machine. Do not send an invented diameter. The checklist does not print a list price or a service life for this piece. Image from the source page: https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/44pr.pdf
body.zh: 在来源标题“应当怎样处理耐久性”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。请用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械。拍下眼镜板，并写明机器上的泵型号。不要自填一个直径。点检没有为这件印出标价或寿命。 图来自来源页：https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/44pr.pdf

question.en: What stays printed for concrete pump spectacle plate when the section heading is “WHAT are Durability Concerns”?
question.zh: 当章节标题是“耐久性要关心哪些问题”时，S阀眼镜板：点检要求观察，尺寸没有印出仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: The published table prints Part type S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit; Large-end sizes listed φ210 / φ220 / φ250 (set; some six-piece); Small-end sizes listed φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105; Unit Set. Those seal-kit cells belong to the S-tube seal page. They are not a size for the spectacle plate. The source heading does not fill an empty cell.
answer.zh: 已公布参数表印有：配件类型S管大端与小端密封套件；已列大端尺寸φ210 / φ220 / φ250（套；部分为六件套）；已列小端尺寸φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105；单位套。这些密封套件格子属于 S 管密封页，不是眼镜板的尺寸。

question.en: What stays printed for concrete pump spectacle plate when the section heading is “WHY should Durability be Addressed”?
question.zh: 当章节标题是“为什么要处理耐久性”时，S阀眼镜板：点检要求观察，尺寸没有印出仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: The photograph on this page is a content image downloaded from the crawled source page. It is not a Pinjin catalogue sheet. A diameter, output, distance or material grade is used here only when the Xingtai table prints it. Figures that are not readable on the photograph stay blank. Another manufacturer's rating is not written onto this Pinjin model or part. The source heading does not fill an empty cell.
answer.zh: 本文图片是从来源页正文下载的内容图，不是品锦目录页。直径、产量、距离或材料牌号，只有邢台参数表印了才写入。照片上读不出来的数字保持空白。其他厂家的参数不写到这个品锦型号或配件上。

question.en: What stays printed for concrete pump spectacle plate when the section heading is “HOW Should Durability be Addressed”?
question.zh: 当章节标题是“应当怎样处理耐久性”时，S阀眼镜板：点检要求观察，尺寸没有印出仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: No. Only cells printed for this Hebei Pinjin Machinery row are used. A matching numeral on a different page is not an assignment. The source heading does not fill an empty cell.
answer.zh: 没有。只用河北品锦机械这一行印出的格子。另一页上相同的数字不等于已经指定到本行。
